chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Hishām ibn Sālim, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام:
Concerning a woman who kills a man: what is due upon her?
He said: “The offender does not bear liability beyond his own self.”

key_terms.الرَّجُلَ: the man; the male victim in the case
key_terms.الْجَانِي: the offender; the one who commits the crime
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman; the female offender in this legal case
key_terms.نَفْسِهِ: his own self; the limit of personal liability

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about the liability of a woman who kills a man?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a case in which a woman kills a man. The Imam عليه السلام states a principle that the perpetrator is not held liable beyond her own person, indicating a limit in criminal liability and retaliation.
